newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - Gas oil firm on back of futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - Gas oil firm on back of futures.

text.p: NWE oil products ended firmer on Monday, traders said.

Gas oil was pulled higher by related IPE futures gains but premiums remained in negative territory with heating oil barges talked around July IPE -50 cents/flat fob ARA and trading around July IPE -25 cents.
Gasoline prices with firmer but off the highs. Traders said the combination of lengthy supplies in the ARA region and the steep $4-5 backwardation into July was keeping buying thin.

Naphtha prices tracked early crude gains but prices drifted back as some of crude's strength was eroded by profit taking over the afternoon. Pipeline spec cargoes offered around mean of published quotes +$1.25 to +$1.50 found little buying interest.

High sulphur fuel oil barges closed steady to a shade firmer at $82.50/$83 after earlier trading at $82.75 and $82. Low sulphur barges were quietly talked at $94/$96, with the offer side unchanged from last week.
High sulphur cargoes were mixed, with some cracked material out of Scandinavia offered at a lower price, but Russian material was priced higher.
